annotations.title: Match a donor request to a giving method

description: Turn a donor's request (e.g. "$50 monthly via card", "mail a check", "Fidelity DAF $5K", "leave them in my will") into the matching Wounded Warriors (EIN 86-1336741) giving method and action URL, with an optional pre-filled amount and frequency. Returns matched_method (check / card / daf / crypto / stock / corporate_match / bequest), confidence, action URL and channel-specific instructions.

amount.description: Optional — donor amount to pre-fill the URL

query.description: Free-text donor intent (e.g. "$50 monthly card", "DAF grant Fidelity", "appreciated stock")

name: match_donor_intent
title: Match a donor request to a giving method
